name: Bharat Agri Fert and Realty Limited
about: Bharat Agri Fert and Realty Limited operates theme-based hospitality resort in India. It operates through three segments: Fertilizer; Realty; and Hospitality. The company operates theme-based resorts under the ANCHAVIYO resort brand name. It also sells single super phosphate. In addition, the company constructs, develops, and sells residential and commercial real estate properties. Further, it manufactures and sells fertilizers. The company was formerly known as Bharat Fertiliser Industries Limited and changed its name to Bharat Agri Fert and Realty Limited in July 2012. Bharat Agri Fert and Realty Limited was founded in 1958 and is based in Mumbai, India.
